meta.method: Read-only GET requests to the Kalshi DEMO Trade API (no authentication). Each row copies values from the JSON response at the listed API URL. Values not present in a response are left blank.
limitations: Only the first page of each query was read. Pagination (cursor) was not followed for Elections, Sports/Golf, Crypto, or Economics.
Demo environment data. Kalshi states prices and behavior in demo may not reflect real markets.
No market-level price history or liquidity was collected for the category tables. Live prices appear on the Live Dashboard page.

flags.topic: Demo data looks synthetic or placeholder
flags.detail: Demo events include close dates in 2099 (e.g., KXNEXTNATOSECGEN-99 and KXELONMARS-99 with close_time 2099-01-08 and 2099-08-01) and a custom_strike field reading 'demo strike'. Kalshi says demo prices 'may not be reflective of those in real markets'. None of these rows should be treated as a real-market signal.

flags.topic: 'Highest dollar amount' cannot be read from volume fields
flags.detail: Kalshi's volume_fp and open_interest_fp are contract counts ('_fp' = contract quantity), not dollars. Prices are in '_dollars' fields. A dollar-volume figure would have to be computed from trade prices times contracts (for example from the Trades endpoint). That computation is not done yet.

flags.topic: Settlement source does not match the contract
flags.detail: KXRIQUAHOG (Rhode Island quahog landings) lists a Federal Reserve Bank of New York SOFR page as its settlement source. A SOFR page does not describe shellfish landings. Row kept off the public tables. Needs review of the contract terms PDF before any use.

flags.topic: Ticker and title disagree
flags.detail: KXBTCMAX130 has the title 'When will bitcoin hit 100k?' but its ticker suffix (MAX130) and its contract-terms file (BTCMINMAX.pdf) do not match that title. The threshold must be confirmed in the contract terms before using the series.

flags.topic: Placeholder and search-engine links in settlement sources
flags.detail: KXXBANNEDMURRAYHILLGUY1 and KXXBANNEDGROK list settlement-source names with unfilled template text (for example 'account holder of', 'official social media accounts of  or their official representatives'), and some entries link to Google search pages rather than to a named source. Settlement rules for these series are unclear from the API.

flags.topic: Gas-price series listed without a market-level snapshot
flags.detail: The AAA gas series rows come from the series list. A market-level price for these series was not returned by a market query during collection (markets?series_ticker=KXAAAGASDTN&status=open returned an empty list). Current prices are therefore not in the table. Update (session f1751c8f, 2026-11-20): open daily markets for KXAAAGASCDOK (e.g. KXAAAGASCDOK-26NOV21-SI/-SD/-MC) were returned with zero volume and zero bid/ask, and three KXAAAGASCDOK-26NOV20 buckets settled NO. See the Market Samples and Resolutions pages. KXAAAGASDTN was not re-queried for open markets in this session.

flags.topic: Event-level settlement sources list mismatched URLs
flags.detail: Some news-outlet names link to different domains than their names suggest (for example 'The Washington Post' linked to abc.com on KXNEWPOPE-70, and 'ABC' linked to abc.net.au, an Australian site). The NATO event is dated to 2099 in the demo data (see F-01).

flags.topic: Settlement source is a third-party data site
flags.detail: KXFDVBIRB (BIRB FDV) lists CoinGecko, a third-party crypto data site, as its settlement source. The contract terms file was not read during collection. Reviewer should confirm the methodology the contract uses.

flags.topic: Vague settlement source list
flags.detail: KXBOASTABLE (BOA stablecoin) lists 14 news outlets as settlement sources with no single authoritative publisher named. Reviewer should confirm which source resolves the contract.

flags.topic: Contract-terms file name does not match the series
flags.detail: KXDPWORLDTOUR (DP World Tour Tournament Winner) points to PGATOUR.pdf as its contract terms file, the same file used by KXPGASOLHEIM. Reviewer should confirm the file covers this series.

flags.topic: Category naming: 'Culture' and 'Golf' do not match Kalshi's tag list
flags.detail: The series endpoint returns a category named 'Culture', but Kalshi's tags_by_categories endpoint has no 'Culture' key. Golf appears only as a tag under Sports. Filters were built on the observed values, so the Culture and Golf pages may differ from what Kalshi's own site shows.

flags.topic: Partial collection
flags.detail: Each query response was longer than one fetch chunk (totalChunks shown in tool output: Golf tag 27, Crypto 35, Elections 522, Sports 841, Economics 115 at the page sizes used). Only chunk 0 (the first page of results) was read for each. The rows are not complete category lists.

flags.topic: List and detail endpoints show different last-updated times
flags.detail: For 9 of 24 rows, the timestamp in the list response (the value first recorded in this snapshot) differs from the same ticker's detail response (last_updated_ts). The table now shows the detail value. The earlier list value is kept in last_updated_list. The Get Series doc defines last_updated_ts as 'Timestamp of when this series' metadata was last updated'. The meaning of the list field was not checked, so the gap is not explained. Rows: R-GAS-01, R-ELC-04, R-ELC-06, R-CRY-01, R-CRY-05, R-CRY-06, R-CRY-07, R-GLF-01, R-GLF-03.

flags.topic: Settlement-source lists were truncated or re-labelled in the earlier snapshot
flags.detail: The settlement-source NAMES in each row were returned by the Kalshi demo detail endpoints (checked by name against data/api_reverification.json). The URLs are a different matter. Only three were opened and confirmed in this session (ABC News, NATO, DP World Tour schedule). Five were wrong for the name (abc.com as The Washington Post, abc.net.au as ABC, a Barchart S&P 500 quote page, an x.com personal account, and Google search URLs). The rest were not opened, so they are blanked under the verification rule. The name stays visible, with a marker, and the URL is recorded in url_as_recorded in the snapshot. Earlier wording said every source was copied verbatim from the endpoint. That overstated what was checked. The earlier list values are kept in settlement_sources_list_count. Counts: confirmed=5, not_confirmed=88, wrong_url=17.
flags.title: Settlement-source links: only three confirmed; the rest blanked

flags.topic: Category label differs for one series
flags.detail: KXAAAGASDTN (Tennessee gas price) was recorded as 'Economics, Commodities' from the list endpoint. Its detail endpoint lists categories ['Economics'] only. The table now shows 'Economics'. KXAAAGASCDOK still lists both categories.

flags.topic: Frequency differs for one series
flags.detail: KXPGARYDERTOP3 (Ryder Cup Top 3 Points Scorer) was recorded as 'annual' from the list endpoint. Its detail endpoint returns frequency 'custom'. The table now shows 'custom'. The title says 'Ryder Cup' while the contract file is NEWACHIEVEMENT.pdf, so the reviewer should confirm the contract terms.

flags.topic: Several series share one contract-terms PDF
flags.detail: The detail endpoints give the same contract-terms file to more than one series: CRYPTOMINMAX.pdf (KXSOLMINMON, KXZECMINMON), CRYPTO.pdf (KXTONW, KXBTCY), and PGATOUR.pdf (KXDPWORLDTOUR, KXPGASOLHEIM). KXBTCMAX130 uses BTCMINMAX.pdf. Shared files may not state the threshold, date, or source for each series. This session did not read the PDFs. A reviewer should open each file and confirm it covers the series before relying on it.

flags.topic: Gas daily outcome not fully recorded
flags.detail: For the 2026-11-20 Oklahoma gas daily event, the three sampled buckets (small increase, small decrease, minimal change) all settled NO. Their rule texts cover non-overlapping ranges of the daily change, so the YES result, if the event has one, is in an unsampled bucket. This table does not record that outcome. A reviewer should query the full event before using the daily result.

flags.topic: No open markets returned for several series
flags.detail: At collection time, the open-market query returned no markets for KXLIVH2H (LIV head-to-head), KXPGAGOLFERSCORE (golf round strokes), KXDPWORLDTOUR (DP World Tour winner), and KXXBANNEDGROK (Grok ban). The golf topic therefore has no open-market sample. Gas (KXAAAGASCDOK), crypto (KXBTCY), elections (KXHFCCHAIR, KXNEWPOPE-70) returned open markets. The open-market sample for this session was limited to the first 3 to 5 markets per query.

flags.topic: Demo test markets appear in settled results
flags.detail: A settled-market query returned demo test markets outside the five topics: KXDEMOFUTHOURLY-26NOV20H11-UP (a BTC threshold with result yes) and KXQUICKSETTLE-20NOV26H0530-2 and -3 ('1+1 = 2' and '1+1 = 3'). They are not in the topic tables and are not used for analysis. They are listed here so a reviewer knows they exist in the API.

flags.topic: Live dashboard listed a ticker that is not in verified data
flags.detail: The live dashboard ticker menu included KXELONMARS-99 (Elon Musk visits Mars). That ticker was not in the verified data and was not checked in this session. It has been removed from the menu. The menu now offers only the six open tickers in the Market Samples page (KXBTCY-27JAN0100 x3, KXNEWPOPE-70 x2, KXHFCCHAIR-26DEC01-KSEL). The two KXNEXTNATOSECGEN-99 tickers were also removed because they are not in the samples (their event response was read, but no market-level price was sampled).

flags.topic: Portfolio, trade execution, and per-trade performance are blocked
flags.detail: Tracking the demo account's portfolio, executing trades, and measuring trade performance need a Kalshi demo account and a signed API key. Both require a human to log in to Kalshi, and this sandbox cannot create them. No credentials were requested, stored, or used. Nothing has been traded. A private key must not be entered into a public GitHub Pages site (see repo flag R-F5).
